name: GIRLS' SYMBIOSIS
source:
A young girl thrown perilously out into the world. A woman endlessly crawling the night, seeking blood and warmth above all else. They can't help but intertwine in ways neither can predict. 

[From [url=https://lunaticker.itch.io/girls-symbiosis]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个年轻的女孩被危险地抛到了这个世界。一个女人在夜色中无休止地爬行，寻求鲜血和温暖高于一切。他们情不自禁地以双方都无法预测的方式交织在一起。

[来自[url=https://lunaticker.itch.io/girls-symbiosis]itch.io[/url]]
